description: The image is a portrait of a young woman wearing a white tank top and blue jeans. She is standing in front of a plain beige background and is posing with her body slightly turned to the side. Her hair is styled in loose waves and she is looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. The tank top is sleeveless and has a scoop neckline. The jeans are high-waisted and have a button-down front. The woman is wearing minimal makeup and her posture is confident and relaxed.
